source: Stake provider directory, collected by hand 2026-09-13
note: Array order is Stake's own ordering and is preserved — it becomes the display rank. `logo` is the imgix asset hash only; scripts/fetch-provider-logos.ts composes the full URL so the size parameters live in one place.
